applicabilityBasis.summary: Brale identifies SBC as a payments-focused USD stablecoin, issued by Brale in partnership with Stable Coin Inc., and redeemable 1:1 for US dollars. Its August reserve examination names Brale Inc.

genius.licensingRegulator: FinCEN / state money transmitter regulators (registered MSB; NMLS ID #2376957; 45 US jurisdictions licensed or exempt)
genius.notes: Reviewed October 7, 2026. Preserve Brale Inc. as the exact legal issuer string, consistent with Brale-issued sibling sidecars (MXNE, USDGLO and USTX). FinCEN MSB registration and state money-transmitter licensing or exemption are ordinary licenses and do not establish GENIUS PPSI approval or state qualification. Brale security disclosures state 45 US jurisdictions licensed or exempt and an EU regulatory application in progress, without a named EU authority or token-specific decision; generic alignment with emerging GENIUS frameworks does not establish a concrete GENIUS application. MCCPA examined reserves and circulation of 8,717,242 SBC as of August 31, 2026 and signed September 15; reserves comprise 8,141,977 cash/cash equivalents and 575,265 US government-backed debt. The SBC archive provides monthly reports. These disclosures establish public reporting, not statutory reserve compliance or authorization. Preserve unknown issuerPathway. GENIUS primary issuer rules remain pre-effective; the general DASP prohibition begins July 18, 2028 under the current timetable.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No token-specific PPSI approval, GENIUS state qualification, official application or stablecoin enforcement action for Brale Inc. and SBC was identified in the reviewed public sources on October 7, 2026. State money-transmitter licensing and generic GENIUS-alignment statements are not such approvals. No claim is made about unpublished applications or unreviewed state records.
